taskVersion.name: ves-synthetic-a-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station T-02 (survey area T). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 31374.7 | 20.07 | 20.07
2 | 7559.9 | 12.79 | 32.86
3 | 3573.3 | 1.62 | 34.48
4 | 313.2 | 38.90 | 73.38
5 | 53.6 | 0.41 | 73.79
6 | 22.8 | - | -

The survey interpretation on file classifies this sounding curve as K-type.

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: T-02
Curve type: K-type
Aquifer depth: 34.48–73.79 m
Recommendation: Focus drilling and well screening within the 313.2–53.6 Ω·m interval (layers 4–5, ~34.5–73.8 m depth), as this marks a pronounced drop in resistivity consistent with a saturated, permeable zone; collect cuttings near the base of this interval to confirm whether the underlying low-resistivity layer (22.8 Ω·m) represents continued aquifer or a clay/confining unit before finalizing well depth.
